_about: Public record of clinical sign-offs: per page only the approved hash (node tools/clinical_lock_check.js --hash=<slug>), the number of sign-offs and the date. Reviewer names, credentials and registrations stay private, in $CUBBY_SIGNOFFS (default ~/cubby-reports/clinical-signoffs/signoffs.json). Entry shape: {"slug": "head-injury-babies", "sha256": "<hash>", "signoffs": 2, "date": "YYYY-MM-DD"}.
